d:
This story of “Dalal News | Dalal Comedians” is packed with sharp political satire. The Dalal Comedians group delivered such punchy humor that the entire atmosphere lit up. From Donald Trump to Bihar’s Samrat Chaudhary, no one was spared as they cracked jokes on media narratives and political drama during the LT Bihar Adda event.
